lines: 1. Kanaan nzaeng Saron mungai,
Rommei nun ruina subaolou na
Kandi hei zing the Saron baolou khou rui;
Gumliammei makna puina nun ni rianra,
Rim gaimei Saron mun baolou khou rui.
2. Saron mun gai baolou khou rui,
Kakhou lung rianra loumei nun khou,
Lily rui puanglou ka niu lungh zinghmei khou;
Kaniu rukhou laokhuan gaanphiu rui gaanguang,
Kaniu bam neihlamei mundiu rim lik.
3. Saron munpuang gaanguang datro,
Zeliangrong kandi zinghmei khou hei;
Muang rui zing e nangpuan gaimei suliam khang,
Neih rui patna nang puan gaimei ndauh o,
Kandimei rui Nang ramgai tei hou khang.
4. Kanaan nzaeng Saron mun gai,
Zeliangrong kandi khou guang datro,
Mbaan thaini the nangbangh nun guai ruin a
Ninga nangta phang the kandihmei nun rui,
Zeliangrong guai ruini neihlani the.
5. He! Saron munta houni the,
Tingkao kandi thu puangmei mun tei,
Siangloumei thingru khou baulou kanmei tei
Tingkao tikgun khou baulou kanmei tei
Tingkao tikgun phunga ringthau dat khou rui,
Houmuh mei paapta rih sutan puni.
